definitions.explanation: A thick, hearty dish of meat and vegetables cooked slowly in liquid. In Japan, this typically refers to either cream stew (white) or beef stew (brown).

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧シチュー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}ろう→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧シチュー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食|た}べたく→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: On cold days, I crave stew.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, シチュー most commonly refers to ⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧シチュー (cream stew), a white stew made with a roux, milk or cream, chicken, and vegetables like carrots, potatoes, and onions. ビーフシチュー (beef stew) is the brown variety. Both are popular home-cooked winter dishes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧シチュー: cream stew (white)
- ビーフシチュー: beef stew (brown)
- シチュー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ルー: stew roux (premade blocks)
